answer.evidence: The whole drawing is a flat front view of a display case. Rows 1-2 are a grey rim. Rows 3-6 are a white band with a red stripe, which reads as a vertical header or label strip. It has no eave shadow and no receding top plane. Row 7 is a thin divider line. Rows 8-28 are glass shelves with meat trays drawn face-on, separated by grey shelf lines at rows 14, 21 and 28. The trays are vertical views and show no contents from above. Width stays at 30 for every row, so nothing widens or narrows into an ellipse and no roof or lid plane is visible. At most a 2-row rim could count as a top, so the case reads as a front elevation.

styleAnswer.evidence: The case is a clean white/grey cabinet with a glass front and rows of red meat packs. It reads as a neat sticker. The measured dark edge pixels are 100% near-neutral, so the outline is a grey/black line with no tint from the neighbouring material. The references use tinted dark brown or red-brown edges (stall-cheese 1% neutral, hedge 0%). The cabinet body has only about 3 steps (white, light grey, dark grey), against about 5-6 on the stall and well. At 9 visible tones per tile the candidate matches the simple hedge but is well under the stall (17) and the well (20). It has no flat 5x5 areas, but the texture is limited to the repeated meat-pack dots, with no grain or speckle on the frame or glass. Neutral outline plus shallow ramps means a careful artist would not accept it next to the stall and well references.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a white and grey fridge case with rows of red meat packs. The measured facts back up what the picture shows. The Beodeul stall and well references use tinted dark-brown outlines, at 1% and 33% neutral. Shading is shallow: the white or pale-grey body has about 3 steps (white, light grey, dark grey), and the glass and frame are almost flat. The red meat packs are tiny repeated blocks with little per-item shading. It has 9 visible tones per tile, against 17 for the cheese stall and 20 for the roofed well. That is about the level of the hedge, but well below the closest comparable furniture props. The neutral outline and shallow ramps make it look thinner than the references.
